items.title: Anthropic bankers prepare to increase IPO valuation to $1.5trn
items.summary: Draft prospectus filed on Tuesday indicates Anthropic's valuation is expected to rise above $1.5trn amid strong investor demand.

items.title: Schemes and trustees urged to prepare now for inheritance tax changes
items.summary: Law firm Sackers warns that bringing most unused pension funds and death benefits into the scope of inheritance tax from 6 April will create administrative challenges.

items.title: Pensions administration must adapt to sector reforms and technology, says PPI
items.summary: Latest research from the Pensions Policy Institute warns that automation and integration do not automatically guarantee better outcomes for pension scheme members.

items.title: Marsh agrees to acquire investment firm Wilshire
items.summary: Marsh has entered into an agreement to purchase global investment consulting and analytics firm Wilshire to expand its investments business.

items.title: London Market brokers fear senior claims talent shortage amid rising risk complexity
items.summary: Research from Tokio Marine Kiln indicates that over a quarter of London Market brokers lack confidence in the industry's ability to retain senior claims expertise over the next decade.

items.title: Conduit trims property book by 10% and grows casualty into soft market
items.summary: Conduit Re enters the January 2027 renewal season with a reduced property book and expanded casualty portfolio as leadership changes approach.
